name: virtual-list
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only VirtualList component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per statics/catalogs/dioxus-components.json and tracked in statics/component_compatibility.json, not shadcn parity. Pure re-export: upstream ships it unstyled, list-item content is entirely caller-composed, and the caller must give the container a bounded height (for example `style: "height: 300px; overflow-y: auto;"`) or the viewport measurement equals the full content height and nothing is virtualized. Its scroll/resize bridge uses native `onscroll`/`onmounted` element queries (no `web`/`desktop` feature gate needed, unlike other overlay primitives) after live browser testing found upstream's own `document::eval`-based bridge never registers in this Dioxus 0.7.9/0.7.10 web runtime -- see provenance. On a renderer without `onscroll`/`onmounted` support (native/server) it renders zero items rather than failing to build -- a documented, explicit target-support skip, not silent, until a proper observer-bridge primitive exists (M6 territory).
